branch_authorization: User explicitly requested this experiment on the current branch, overriding AGENTS.md new-branch default.
seed_scope: Python, NumPy and torch inference seeds; Kev uses argmax and has no request sampling seed. These are repeatability runs, not independently trained models.
baseline_policy: Reuse exact saved Chronos-2 main-table forecasts per region/seed; never retrain or overwrite original baseline outputs.
quantile_policy: Sort native quantiles for diagnostics and Agent tools, identical to the shared scoring rearrangement; preserve native selected predictions in artifacts.
test_exposure: This test period was used in earlier project versions; R17 is frozen before this run and will not be tuned on its outcomes.
score_policy: Read labels only after all nine cells finish; shared aligned scorer; equal-region mean then seed mean and population std; paired circular 168-hour-block bootstrap, 2000 draws, averaging repeated seeds before resampling.
